title: LeviVision Config
description: Persistent settings for LeviVision visual modules.

nightVision.title: Night Vision
nightVision.description: Enables full brightness / night vision effect.

xray.title: X-Ray
xray.description: Makes non-ore blocks transparent to reveal ores.

glowOres.title: Glow Ores
glowOres.description: Applies emissive highlight to ore blocks.

renderDistance.title: Render Distance
renderDistance.description: Block radius used by X-Ray / Glow scanning.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.description: Opacity of non-ore blocks when X-Ray is enabled (0-100).

glowStrength.title: Glow Strength
glowStrength.description: Intensity of the emissive ore highlight (0-100).
